involves.heading: What Heating Services Involve
involves.body: Heating services from Carolina Heating Service cover the full lifecycle of your system: heating repair for immediate problems, heating replacement when a repair no longer makes sense, and heating system installation for new construction or equipment upgrades in Greenville, SC. Furnaces heat air and distribute it through ductwork. Heat pumps and geothermal systems move existing heat rather than generate it, which can lower energy costs. Smart thermostats let you control and schedule your system precisely. Carolina Heating Service installs, repairs, and replaces:
bullets: Furnaces, including gas and electric systems
Heat pump systems, including air handlers

signs.heading: Signs You Need Heating Repair or Replacement
signs.body: A heating system nearing 15 to 20 years old, needing frequent repairs, or struggling to keep up with the thermostat setting is often more expensive to keep repairing than to replace. Rising energy bills without a clear cause, uneven heating between rooms, or a system that's louder than it used to be are all signs worth having checked. A technician can inspect your system and quote both heating repair and replacement, so you can compare the real cost of each option before deciding.
